Axiom: `## Critic Rounds` is memory that lives in exactly ONE primary artifact for the canonical target-set, not in the orchestrator's own context and not duplicated into secondary bundle members. It survives a context reset, a crashed session, or a fresh fallback sensor that never saw a prior round. Append-only inside one stable review-set/write-set cycle: each round adds one dated entry (verdict, target-set, write-set, changed-state, dispatch disposition, accepted, rejected-with-reason, reconcile decisions, changes, out-of-cycle deferrals, and any operator decision); a prior entry is never rewritten. This makes the critique loop converge across rounds and sessions: the sensor reads the primary history together with every bounded target artifact, so settled ground is not re-litigated. Keep the block through `npx gennady sdd-check --review-ready ` and exact `npx gennady sdd-check --review-publication [secondary...]`. An integrated lifecycle retains it through semantic-finalization corrections and the final delta-only operator disposition; those corrections continue the same numbered cycle and cannot reset the five-result cap. Remove scratch only as the last review-scaffolding mutation after final bytes are stable and accepted; no artifact edit may follow. A direct critic pause/continuation retains it too. A changed target-set or promoted write-set starts a new Round 1 cycle rather than appending incompatible evidence. Continuation authorization is not readiness.
